questions.text: हड़प्पा पुरास्थलों में अन्न भंडारों का होना संभवतः उनकी कृषि पद्धतियों के बारे में निम्नलिखित में से क्या संकेत देता है ?
questions.text_english: The presence of granaries at Harappan sites most likely implies which of the following about their agricultural practices ?
questions.solution: The correct answer is Surplus Production. Granaries were large storage facilities, implying that the Harappan civilization produced more food than was immediately needed for consumption, which allowed for storage, trade, and sustaining non-agricultural urban populations.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में शुंगों और कण्वों के बारे में कौन-सा कथन सही है ?
questions.text_english: Which of the following statement is correct about the Shungas and Kanvas?

options.A: शुंगों ने बौद्धधर्म का और कण्वों ने हिंदूधर्म का समर्थन किया।
options.B: शुंग और कण्व मौर्यों के तात्कालिक उत्तराधिकारी थे।
options.C: शुंगों और कण्वों ने गुप्त शासकों के बाद शासन किया ।
options.D: शुंग मौर्यों के उत्तराधिकारी बने और कण्व गुप्त शासकों के उत्तराधिकारी बने ।

options_english.A: The Shungas supported Buddhism and the Kanvas supported Hinduism.
options_english.B: The Shungas and the Kanvas were the immediate successors of the Mauryas.
options_english.C: The Shungas and the Kanvas ruled after the Gupta rulers.
options_english.D: The Shungas succeeded the Mauryas and the Kanvas succeeded the Gupta rulers.

questions.solution: The Shungas and Kanvas were the immediate successors of the Mauryas. After the decline of the Mauryan Empire, Pushyamitra Shunga overthrew the last Mauryan ruler, Brihadratha, to establish the Shunga dynasty, which was later succeeded by the Kanvas.

questions.text:
नीचे दो कथन अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दिए गए हैं। इनको ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए और सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :

अभिकथन (A) : 19वीं सदी में शाहजहाँ बेगम कला और वास्तुकला की संरक्षक थीं, जिन्हें साँची के सरंक्षण में उनके योगदान के लिए जाना जाता है।
कारण (R) : साँची स्तूप प्रारंभिक बौद्ध वास्तुकला का उत्कृष्ट उदाहरण है।
questions.text_english:
Two statements labelled as Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are given below. Read them carefully and select the correct option:

Assertion (A): Shahjehan Begum was a patron of art and architecture in the 19th century, known for her contribution for Sanchi's preservation.
Reason (R): Sanchi Stupa is a classical example of early Buddhist architecture.

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सही हैं और कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सही हैं, परन्तु कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सही है, परन्तु कारण (R) ग़लत है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) ग़लत है, परन्तु कारण (R) सही है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: The correct option is (B). Both statements are factually true. Shahjehan Begum did patronize the preservation of Sanchi. However, the reason why she protected it (that it is a classical example of early Buddhist architecture) does not explain why she, as a 19th-century patron, was specifically the one to do it; these are two separate historical facts.

questions.text: नीचे दिए गए चित्र को देखिए और इस ऐतिहासिक शिल्पकृति की पहचान कीजिए :
questions.text_english: Look at the image given below and identify the historical artefact:
questions.solution: The correct answer is Ashoka's Lion Capital. This iconic sculpture was originally atop the Ashoka pillar at Sarnath and is recognized by its four lions standing back-to-back and the wheel symbol, which now serves as the National Emblem of India.

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित में से कौन-से कथन प्राचीन भारत के सिक्कों का सटीक वर्णन करते हैं ?
I. प्राचीन पार्थियन सोने के सिक्के उत्तर भारत में व्यापक व्यापार को दर्शाते हैं।
II. दक्षिण भारत में प्राचीन रोमन सिक्के सीमाओं से परे व्यापार का संकेत देते हैं।
III. प्राचीन यौधेयों द्वारा जारी किए गए ताँबे के सिक्कों ने उनकी आर्थिक गतिविधि पर प्रकाश डाला।
IV. प्राचीन गुप्त शासकों द्वारा जारी किए गए चाँदी के सिक्कों ने व्यापार को सुविधाजनक बनाया ।
questions.text_english:
Which of the following statements accurately describes the coinage of ancient India?
I. Ancient Parthian gold coins showed extensive trade in north India.
II. Ancient Roman coins in South India indicated trade beyond borders.
III. Ancient Yaudheyas issued copper coins that highlighted their economic activity.
IV. Ancient Gupta rulers issued silver coins that facilitated trade.

options.A: I, II और IV सही हैं।
options.B: II, III और IV सही हैं।
options.C: I, III और IV सही हैं।
options.D: I, II और III सही हैं。

options_english.A: I, II and IV are correct.
options_english.B: II, III and IV are correct.
options_english.C: I, III and IV are correct.
options_english.D: I, II and III are correct.

questions.solution: The correct option is (D). Statements I, II, and III are historically accurate regarding ancient trade and coinage. Statement IV is incorrect because while Gupta rulers issued excellent gold coins, their silver coins were limited in circulation or influence compared to their gold coinage in the context of facilitating trade generally.

questions.text:
दिए गए विकल्पों में से उचित शब्द से रिक्त स्थान की पूर्ति कीजिए :
जैन दर्शन में जन्म और पुनर्जन्म का चक्र _______ के द्वारा निर्धारित होता है।
questions.text_english:
Fill in the blank with the appropriate word from the given options.
In Jaina philosophy, the cycle of birth and rebirth is influenced by .
questions.solution: The correct word is Karma. In Jain philosophy, one's actions (Karma) determine the cycle of birth and rebirth, and individuals must shed all karma to achieve liberation (Moksha).

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित जानकारी की सहायता से प्राचीन भारत के शासक की पहचान कीजिए और सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :

questions.text_english:
Identify the ancient ruler of India with the help of following information and choose the correct option:
• Was the best known ruler of the Satavahana dynasty.
• Claimed to be a unique Brahmana.
• Was the son of Rishi Vashistha.
questions.solution: The correct answer is Gotami-puta Siri-Satakani. Historical inscriptions describe him as 'ekabamhana' (a unique Brahmana) and he is a prominent figure in Satavahana dynasty history.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित स्तंभ I का स्तंभ II से मिलान कीजिए और सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :

questions.solution: The correct match is Khwaja Qutbuddin Bakhtiyar Kaki, who was based in Delhi. Other options are incorrectly matched regarding their primary centers.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से किस मंदिर के पुजारी ने वे स्मृतियाँ प्रदान कीं, जो हम्पी के प्रारंभिक सर्वेक्षण के लिए महत्त्वपूर्ण थीं ?
questions.text_english: Which of the following temple's priest provided memories that were crucial for the initial survey of Hampi ?
questions.solution: The correct answer is the Virupaksha Temple. Its priests were instrumental in providing the memories and historical information needed by Colin Mackenzie and other early surveyors to understand the history and significance of Hampi.

questions.text: आइन-ए-अकबरी की 'मुल्क आबादी' की निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी विशेषता इतिहासकारों को मुगल साम्राज्य की प्रशासनिक संरचना को समझने में सहायक है ?
questions.text_english: Which of the following features of 'Mulk Abadi' of Ain-i-Akbari helps historians to understand the administrative structure of the Mughal Empire ?
questions.solution: The 'Mulk Abadi' of the Ain-i-Akbari provides detailed fiscal records, including land revenue assessments, which are crucial for historians to analyze the Mughal administration and economic management.

questions.text:

कार्ल मार्क्स की 'एशियाई उत्पादन पद्धति' की अवधारणा ने ग्रामीण समाज को _______ दर्शाया।
questions.text_english:
Fill in the blank :
Karl Marx's concept of 'Asiatic mode of production' depicted rural society as
questions.solution: Karl Marx described the rural society under the 'Asiatic mode of production' as egalitarian, implying that the community held land collectively, although this view has been debated by historians.

questions.text: तंजावुर जैसे स्थानों पर स्थित चोल मंदिर प्राचीन इतिहास में क्यों महत्त्वपूर्ण हैं ?
questions.text_english: Why are Chola temples at places like Thanjavur significant in ancient history?

options.A: इन्हें भारत के सबसे पहले मंदिरों के रूप में जाना जाता है।
options.B: वे वास्तुकला में चोल संरक्षण के शिखर को चिह्नित करते हैं।
options.C: इनका निर्माण पांड्या शासकों की सहायता से किया गया ।
options.D: वे त्योहारों के दौरान किलों के रूप में कार्य करते थे ।

options_english.A: They are known as the very first temples in India.
options_english.B: They mark the peak of Chola patronage in architecture.
options_english.C: They were constructed with the help of the Pandya rulers.
options_english.D: They served as forts during festivals.

questions.solution: Chola temples like the Brihadiswara Temple in Thanjavur are architectural marvels that mark the pinnacle of Chola patronage, demonstrating advanced engineering and artistic expression.

questions.text: विजयनगर साम्राज्य के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा जोड़ा सही सुमेलित है ?
questions.text_english: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched regarding the Vijayanagara empire?

options.A: बीजापुर के सुल्तान की पराजय - अराविदु वंश की शुरुआत

questions.solution: The correct match is the Founding of Nagalapuram, a township built by Krishnadeva Raya named after his mother, Nagaladevi.

questions.text: अंग्रेज़ों ने बम्बई में 'इस्तमरारी बंदोबस्त' की अपेक्षा 'रैयतवाड़ी व्यवस्था' को क्यों प्राथमिकता दी ?
questions.text_english: Why did the British prefer the 'Ryotwari system' in Bombay over the 'Permanent Settlement'?

options.A: राजस्व संग्रह को सरल बनाने के लिए
options.C: अपने राजस्व को बढ़ाने के लिए

questions.solution: The British preferred the Ryotwari system to maximize their revenue directly from the cultivators, avoiding the intermediary zamindars who would take a cut of the profits.

अभिकथन (A) : अमेरिकी गृहयुद्ध ने ब्रिटेन में कपास क्षेत्र (मंडी तथा कारखानों) में खलबली मचा दी।
कारण (R) : अमेरिकी कपास की आपूर्ति में भारी गिरावट आई, जिससे भारतीय कपास की माँग बढ़ गई थी。
questions.text_english:
Two statements labelled as Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are given below. Read them carefully and select the correct option:
Assertion (A): The American Civil War created a panic in the cotton circles in Britain.
Reason (R): American cotton supplies had dropped drastically which increased the demand for Indian cotton.

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सही हैं और कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सही हैं, परन्तु कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सही है, परन्तु कारण (R) ग़लत है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) ग़लत है, परन्तु कारण (R) सही है。

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: The correct option is (A). Both statements are true. The interruption in American cotton supply due to the Civil War caused a panic in British industry, which in turn significantly boosted the demand for Indian cotton as an alternative.

questions.text_english:
(a) How did different types of marriages reflect the social systems of ancient India during the Mahabharata Period? Explain with examples.

OR

(b) How did familial relations impact the social systems of India during the Mahabharata Period? Explain with examples.

sub_questions.text: महाभारत काल के दौरान विभिन्न प्रकार के विवाह प्राचीन भारत की सामाजिक प्रणाली को कैसे प्रतिबिंबित करते थे ?
sub_questions.text_english: How did different types of marriages reflect the social systems of ancient India during the Mahabharata Period?
sub_questions.solution: Marriage rules during the Mahabharata period, such as exogamy (marrying outside the clan/gotra), were crucial for maintaining social order. The Dharma Shastras classified marriages, with 'kanyadana' (gift of a daughter) being highly regarded. These rules reflected the preoccupation with maintaining caste purity and reinforcing patriarchal social structures through controlled marital alliances.

questions.solution: Ancient social systems were heavily reflected through marriage practices. Rules such as gotra exogamy were meant to prevent lineage overlap, while the classification of marriages into approved forms (like Brahma) and others reflected the dominance of patriarchal and Brahminical norms. These practices helped structure familial ties and social inheritance.

questions.text: पौराणिक हिंदू धर्म ने वैष्णववाद और शैववाद के विकास में कैसे योगदान किया ? स्पष्ट कीजिए।
questions.text_english: How has Puranic Hinduism contributed to the development of Vaishnavism and Shaivism? Explain.
questions.solution: Puranic Hinduism facilitated the development of Vaishnavism and Shaivism by elevating Vishnu and Shiva as supreme deities. It integrated local, folk, and regional traditions with established Vedic practices, often representing the deity through worship, meditation, and devotion (Bhakti), which allowed these traditions to become accessible to a wider section of society.

questions.text:
(क) “पंचायतों ने मुगल ग्रामीण समाज में महत्त्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाई।उपयुक्त तर्कों के साथ इस कथन को न्यायसंगत ठहराइए।

अथवा

(ख) “कुछ जंगलवासी समुदायों ने राजनीतिक स्वतंत्रता का एक महत्त्वपूर्ण स्तर बनाए रखा ।मुगल साम्राज्य के संदर्भ में इस कथन की परख कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
(a) Panchayats played a crucial role in the Mughal rural society.Justify the statement with suitable arguments.

OR

(b) Many forest-dwelling communities maintained a significant level of political independence.Examine the statement in the context of Mughal empire.
questions.solution:
(a) Panchayats were essential to Mughal rural society as they functioned as self-governing bodies of the village elders. They mediated disputes between villagers, ensured the collection of taxes, enforced caste norms, and represented village interests before the state officials, thus acting as the primary point of local administration.

(b) Many forest-dwelling communities were located in regions difficult to access. Their nomadic or semi-nomadic lifestyles allowed them to evade central state authority. By maintaining their traditional governance and utilizing local resources, they preserved a level of political autonomy, though they occasionally interacted with the empire through tribute or trade.

questions.text: इस्तमरारी बंदोबस्त व्यवस्था में जोतेदारों की भूमिका का विश्लेषण कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Analyse the role of Jotedars in the Permanent Settlement system.
questions.solution: Jotedars were wealthy peasants in Bengal who played a dominant role in the rural economy during the Permanent Settlement. They held vast amounts of land, controlled local agricultural trade, and provided loans to poorer cultivators. They often resisted the authority of the Zamindars and consolidated their power within the village, making them a significant force in the local socio-economic structure.

questions.text: भारतीय चित्रण ने रानी लक्ष्मीबाई के 1857 के विद्रोह के योगदान को कैसे जीवित रखा ? स्पष्ट कीजिए।
questions.text_english: How has Indian imagery preserved Rani Laxmibai's contribution during the Revolt of 1857? Explain.
questions.solution: Indian imagery has preserved Rani Laxmibai's legacy by depicting her as a powerful warrior figure, typically shown on horseback with a child tied to her back and a sword in hand. This visual representation transformed her into a national icon, symbolizing fearlessness and resistance against British colonial rule, ensuring her role in the 1857 revolt remains a central part of India's collective memory.

questions.text: कल्पना कीजिए कि आप मीराबाई के जीवन पर एक प्रोजेक्ट बना रहे हैं। आप उनकी कविताओं में भक्ति की भावनाओं को कैसे स्पष्ट करेंगे ?
questions.text_english: Imagine you are creating a project on Mirabai's life. How would you explain the emotions of devotion in her poetry?
questions.solution: In my project, I would explain Mirabai's devotion as 'Viraha-bhakti', characterized by deep, unconditional love for Lord Krishna. Her poetry reflects the pain of separation and a personal, intimate bond that transcends conventional religious and social boundaries. Her defiance of royal and patriarchal norms to seek the Divine highlights the intensity and purity of her spiritual emotions.

questions.text:
(क) हड़प्पा की पुरातात्त्विक खोजें सिंधु घाटी सभ्यता के शहरी नियोजन की व्याख्या कैसे करती हैं ? उदाहरणों सहित स्पष्ट कीजिए।

अथवा

(ख) समय के साथ पुरातत्त्वविदों की भूमिकाओं और कार्यप्रणालियों ने हड़प्पा सभ्यता को समझने में कैसे योगदान दिया है ? उदाहरणों सहित स्पष्ट कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
(a) How do the archaeological discoveries at Harappa explain urban planning of the Indus Valley Civilization? Explain with examples.

OR

(b) How have the roles and methodologies of archaeologists contributed to the understanding of Harappan Civilization over time? Explain with examples.
questions.solution:
(a) Archaeological findings reveal that Harappan urban planning was highly systematic. The grid-like street layout, advanced drainage systems in houses, the use of standardized baked bricks, and the construction of the citadel and lower town reflect an organized civic authority and concern for hygiene, which characterize a complex urban civilization.

(b) Over time, archaeological methodologies have evolved from simple exploration to systematic excavation and now scientific analysis. Early archaeologists like Cunningham, followed by Marshall and Mortimer Wheeler, used stratigraphic digging and multidisciplinary approaches. Recent techniques like DNA analysis and GIS have allowed us to understand trade routes, diet, and demographic shifts, providing a more comprehensive view of the civilization than previously possible.

questions.text:
(क) विरुपाक्ष मंदिर हम्पी में स्थित एक ऐतिहासिक मंदिर है। इसकी कौन-सी विशेषताएँ इसे विजयनगर साम्राज्य की वास्तुकला और सांस्कृतिकी का प्रमुख स्थल बनाती हैं ? स्पष्ट कीजिए।

अथवा

(ख) विजयनगर का राजकीय केन्द्र महत्त्वपूर्ण था। इसकी वास्तुकला की कौन-सी विशेषताएँ इसे महत्त्वपूर्ण सांस्कृतिक स्थल बनाती हैं ? स्पष्ट कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
(a) The Virupaksha Temple is a historic temple located in Hampi. What features make it a key architectural and cultural landmark of the Vijayanagara Empire ? Explain.

OR

(b) The Royal Centre in Vijayanagara was significant. Which architectural features make it an important cultural landmark ? Explain.
questions.solution:
(a) The Virupaksha Temple is significant due to its massive 'gopurams', detailed intricate carvings, and extensive courtyards. It symbolizes the patronage of Vijayanagara kings and their religious legitimacy. The temple served as the hub of cultural and religious festivals, reflecting the empire's devotion and prosperity.

(b) The Royal Centre, which housed the palaces and the Audience Hall, is a landmark due to structures like the Lotus Mahal and the Mahanavami Dibba. Its unique fusion of indigenous and Islamic architectural styles highlights the empire's cosmopolitan nature and strategic focus on display of power and religious ceremonies.

questions.text:
(क) भारतीय राष्ट्रीय आंदोलन में गाँधीजी के योगदानों को पूरी तरह समझने के लिए विभिन्न स्रोत आवश्यक हैं।” इस कथन को न्यायसंगत ठहराइए।

(ख) “1930 में 'नमक यात्रा' में गाँधीजी का नेतृत्व ब्रिटिश औपनिवेशिक शासन के विरुद्ध प्रतिरोध का प्रतीक बन गया।इस कथन को न्यायसंगत ठहराइए।
questions.text_english:
(a) Various sources are essential for a complete understanding of Gandhiji's contributions in the Indian National Movement.Justify the statement.

OR

(b) Gandhiji's leadership in the 'Salt March' of 1930 became a symbol of resistance against British colonial rule.Justify the statement.
questions.solution:
(a) To understand Gandhiji's multifaceted contributions, historians must rely on a variety of sources: personal correspondence, public speeches recorded by police (Fortnightly Reports), contemporary newspapers like The Harijan or Young India, and private diaries of his associates. Each provides different perspectives—official, public, and intimate—that help form a balanced view of his political influence.

(b) The Salt March of 1930 was a masterstroke of political symbolism. By targeting salt—a basic necessity taxed by the British—Gandhiji linked the struggle for freedom to everyday life. The march drew massive public participation, invited international media attention, and effectively challenged the moral legitimacy of British colonial rule, uniting diverse sections of Indian society.
questions.chapter: Mahatma Gandhi and the Nationalist Movement

questions.text:
दिए गए स्रोत को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए और इसके नीचे दिए गए प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए :

पाटलिपुत्र का इतिहास

प्रत्येक नगर का अपना इतिहास था । उदाहरण के तौर पर, पाटलिपुत्र का विकास पाटलिग्राम नाम के एक गाँव से हुआ। फिर पाँचवीं सदी ई.पू. में मगध शासकों ने अपनी राजधानी राजगाह से हटाकर इसे बस्ती में लाने का निर्णय किया और इसका नाम बदल दिया। चौथी शताब्दी ई.पू. तक आते-आते यह मौर्य साम्राज्य की राजधानी और एशिया के सबसे बड़े नगरों में से एक बन गया। बाद में इसका महत्त्व कम हो गया और जब चीनी यात्री श्वैन त्सांग सातवीं सदी ई. में यहाँ आया तो इसे यह नगर खंडहर में बदला मिला और उस समय यहाँ की जनसंख्या भी कम थी।
questions.text_english:
Read the given source carefully and answer the questions that follow:

The History of Pataliputra

Each city had a history of its own. Pataliputra, for instance, began as a village known as Pataligrama. Then, in the fifth century BCE, the Magadhan rulers decided to shift their capital from Rajagaha to this settlement and renamed it. By the fourth century BCE, it was the capital of the Mauryan Empire and one of the largest cities in Asia. Subsequently, its importance apparently declined. When the Chinese pilgrim Xuan Zang visited the city in the seventh century CE, he found it in ruins, and with a very small population.

sub_questions.text: राजगाह से पाटलिपुत्र में स्थानांतरण के मगध साम्राज्य पर पड़े मुख्य प्रभाव की परख कीजिए ।
sub_questions.text_english: Examine the main impact of the shift from Rajagaha to Pataliputra, on the Magadhan empire.
sub_questions.solution: The shift centralized power and military administration, enabling Magadha to grow from a regional kingdom into the dominant power of the Mauryan Empire.

sub_questions.text: श्वैन त्सांग पाटलिपुत्र के बारे में क्या संदेश देना चाहता था ?
sub_questions.text_english: What message did Xuan Zang wish to convey about Pataliputra ?
sub_questions.solution: Xuan Zang conveyed that the once-glorious capital had declined significantly, illustrating the transience of political power over time.

sub_questions.text: मगध साम्राज्य के इतिहास में पाटलिपुत्र की क्या भूमिका थी ?
sub_questions.text_english: What role did Pataliputra play in the history of the Magadhan empire?
sub_questions.solution: Pataliputra served as the strategic political and administrative heart of the Mauryan Empire, symbolizing the peak of its power and influence in ancient Asia.

questions.text:
दिए गए स्रोत को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए और इसके नीचे दिए गए प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए :

राजकीय कारखाने

संभवतः बर्नियर एकमात्र ऐसा इतिहासकार है जो राजकीय कारखानों की कार्यप्रणाली का विस्तृत विवरण प्रदान करता है :

कई स्थानों पर बड़े कक्ष दिखाई देते हैं जिन्हें कारखाना अथवा शिल्पकारों की कार्यशाला कहते हैं। एक कक्ष में कसीदाकार एक मास्टर के निरीक्षण में व्यस्तता से कार्यरत रहते हैं। एक अन्य में आप सुनारों को देखते हैं; तीसरे में, चित्रकार; चौथे में, प्रलाक्षा रस का रोगन लगाने वाले; पाँचवें में बढ़ई, खरादी, दर्जी तथा जूते बनाने वाले; छठे में रेशम, जरी तथा महीन मलमल का काम करने वाले...

शिल्पकार अपने कारखानों में हर रोज़ सुबह आते हैं जहाँ वे पूरे दिन कार्यरत रहते हैं; और शाम को अपने-अपने घर चले जाते हैं। इसी निश्चेष्ट नियमित ढंग से उनका समय बीतता जाता है; कोई भी जीवन की उन स्थितियों में सुधार करने का इच्छुक नहीं है जिनमें वह पैदा हुआ था ।
questions.text_english:
Read the given source carefully and answer the questions that follow:

The imperial karkhanas

Bernier is perhaps the only historian who provides a detailed account of the working of the imperial karkhanas or workshops:

Large halls are seen at many places, called karkhanas or workshops for the artisans. In one hall, embroiderers are busily employed, superintended by a master. In another, you see the goldsmiths; in a third, painters; in a fourth, varnishers in lacquer-work; in a fifth, joiners, turners, tailors and shoe-makers; in a sixth, manufacturers of silk, brocade and fine muslins

The artisans come every morning to their karkhanas where they remain employed the whole day; and in the evening return to their homes. In this quiet regular manner, their time glides away; no one aspiring for any improvement in the condition of life wherein he happens to be born.

sub_questions.text: बर्नियर का विवरण मुगल साम्राज्य में कारखानों के आर्थिक महत्त्व को कैसे दर्शाता है ?
sub_questions.text_english: How did Bernier's description reflect the economic significance of the karkhanas in the Mughal empire ?
sub_questions.solution: Bernier's account shows that karkhanas were hubs of organized production for high-value goods like silk, fine muslin, and jewelry, contributing significantly to the economy.

sub_questions.text: कारखानों में शिल्प मुगल साम्राज्य की सांस्कृतिक विविधता को कैसे दर्शाते हैं ?
sub_questions.text_english: How did the crafts in the karkhanas reflect the cultural diversity of the Mughal empire ?
sub_questions.solution: The variety of crafts, from fine textiles to lacquer-work and embroidery, illustrates the patronage of diverse arts and the high aesthetic standards of Mughal culture.

sub_questions.text: मुगल साम्राज्य और उसके कारीगरों के बीच संबंध का विश्लेषण कीजिए
sub_questions.text_english: Analyse the relationship between the Mughal empire and its artisans.
sub_questions.solution: The empire exercised a rigid, supervised structure over artisans in the karkhanas, ensuring production of luxury goods for the imperial household, while the artisans remained largely within their traditional familial social and occupational structures.

questions.text:
दिए गए स्रोत को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए और इसके नीचे दिए गए प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए :

हमने एक स्वतंत्र संप्रभु गणराज्य की स्थापना का दृढ़ और पवित्र संकल्प लिया है। भारत का संप्रभु होना नियत है । इसका स्वतंत्र होना और गणराज्य होना भी स्वाभाविक है...। कुछ मित्रों ने सवाल उठाया है : आपने यहाँ 'लोकतांत्रिक' शब्द क्यों नहीं रखा।मैंने उन्हें कहा है कि निस्संदेह यह सोचा जा सकता है कि कोई गणराज्य लोकतांत्रिक न हो परंतु हमारा पूरा इतिहास इस तथ्य का साक्षी है कि हम लोकतांत्रिक संस्थानों के ही पक्षधर हैं। स्वाभाविक है कि हमारा लक्ष्य लोकतंत्र है। लोकतंत्र से कम कुछ भी नहीं। यह लोकतंत्र कैसा होगा, उसकी शक्ल-सूरत कैसी होगी, यह एक अलग मसला है ? आज के लोकतंत्रों ने दुनिया की प्रगति में जबरदस्त भूमिका निभायी है और उनमें से बहुत सारे यूरोप तथा अन्य स्थानों के देश हैं। परंतु यह संदेहजनक हो सकता है कि अगर उन्हें पूरी तरह लोकतांत्रिक बने रहना है तो न जाने कब उन लोकतंत्रों को अपनी शक्ल-सूरत थोड़ी बहुत बदलनी पड़ती । मैं आशा करता हूँ कि किसी कथित लोकतांत्रिक देश की एक खास लोकतांत्रिक प्रणाली या किसी संस्थान विशेष की हम सिर्फ नकल करने वाले नहीं हैं। हो सकता है कि हम उससे बेहतर कुछ रच दें। बहरहाल, किसी भी सूरत में, हम यहाँ जैसी चाहे सरकार बनाएँ, वह हमारे लोगों के स्वभाव के अनुरूप और उनको स्वीकार्य ज़रूर होनी चाहिए। हम लोकतंत्र के हक में हैं। यह इस सदन को तय करना है कि इस लोकतंत्र, पूर्णतम लोकतंत्र का स्वरूप कैसा होगा। सदन इस बात को देख सकता है यद्यपि इस प्रस्ताव में हमने लोकतांत्रिकशब्द का इस्तेमाल नहीं किया है क्योंकि हमें लगा कि यह तो स्वाभाविक ही है कि गणराज्यशब्द में यह शब्द पहले ही निहित होता है। इसलिए हम अनावश्यक और अनुपयोगी शब्दों का प्रयोग नहीं करना चाहते थे। हमने शब्दों के उपयोग मात्र से कहीं ज़्यादा ध्यान दिया है। हमने इस प्रस्ताव में लोकतंत्र की अंतर्वस्तु प्रस्तुत की है। बल्कि लोकतंत्र की ही नहीं, आर्थिक लोकतंत्र की अंतर्वस्तु प्रस्तुत की है। अन्य सदस्यों को इस बात पर आपत्ति हो सकती है कि इस प्रस्ताव में हमने भारत को एक समाजवादी राज्य बनाने का उल्लेख क्यों नहीं किया है। यहाँ मेरा केवल इतना ही कहना है कि मैं समाजवाद का समर्थक हूँ और मुझे आशा है कि एक दिन भारत भी समाजवाद के पक्ष में होगा और वही भारत एक समाजवादी राज्य की स्थापना के मार्ग पर चलेगा और मुझे पूरा विश्वास है कि एक दिन पूरी दुनिया को इसी मार्ग पर चलना होगा।
questions.text_english:
Read the given source carefully and answer the questions that follow:

We say that it is our firm and solemn resolve to have an independent sovereign republic. India is bound to be sovereign, it is bound to be independent and it is bound to be a republic... Now, some friends have raised the question: Why have you not put in the word 'democratic' here?Well, I told them that it is conceivable, of course, that a republic may not be democratic but the whole of our past is witness to this fact that we stand for democratic institutions. Obviously we are aiming at democracy and nothing less than a democracy. What form of democracy, what shape it might take is another matter. The democracies of the present day, many of them in Europe and elsewhere, have played a great part in the world's progress. Yet it may be doubtful if those democracies may not have to change their shape somewhat before long if they have to remain completely democratic. We are not going just to copy, I hope, a certain democratic procedure or an institution of a so-called democratic country. We may improve upon it. In any event whatever system of government we may establish here must fit in with the temper of our people and be acceptable to them. We stand for democracy. It will be for this House to determine what shape to give to that democracy, the fullest democracy, I hope. The House will notice that in this Resolution, although we have not used the word democraticbecause we thought it is obvious that the word republiccontains that word and we did not want to use unnecessary words and redundant words, but we have done something much more than using the word. We have given the content of democracy in this Resolution and not only the content of democracy but the content, if I may say so, of economic democracy in this Resolution. Others might take objection to this Resolution on the ground that we have not said that it should be a Socialist State. Well, I stand for Socialism and, I hope, India will stand for Socialism and that India will go towards the constitution of a Socialist State and I do believe that the whole world will have to go that way.

sub_questions.text: भारत को 'गणराज्य' के रूप में परिभाषित करने से लोकतांत्रिक शासन को कैसे बढ़ावा मिला ?
sub_questions.text_english: How did defining India as a 'republic' enhance democratic governance?
sub_questions.solution: Defining India as a republic affirmed its sovereignty and the commitment to democratic institutions, as the term inherently implied the participation of the people in governance.

sub_questions.text: आर्थिक लोकतंत्र ने गणराज्य के ढाँचे में सामाजिक समानता को कैसे बढ़ावा दिया ?
sub_questions.text_english: How does economic democracy promote social equality within a republican framework?
sub_questions.solution: Economic democracy promotes equality by ensuring that political freedom is supported by equitable access to resources, aiming to reduce disparities and lift living standards for all.

sub_questions.text: जवाहरलाल नेहरू ने भारत में लोकतंत्र को आकार देने में संविधान सभा की भूमिका को कैसे देखा ?
sub_questions.text_english: How did Jawaharlal Nehru view the role of the Constituent Assembly in shaping democracy in India?
sub_questions.solution: Nehru viewed the Constituent Assembly as the responsible body tasked with defining the specific nature of India's democracy, ensuring it fit the 'temper of our people' rather than just copying Western models.
